Name: Elle's Cuter Cats
Author: junimods
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43062/43062-1775954086-1833789386.png[/img]﻿
[Alt text: A banner with text that reads "Features"]

- Uses the new 1.6 feature to add new pet breeds, rather than replacing vanilla sprites!
- Provides 158 skins to choose from! There are color variations for the following breeds/color patterns:
﻿- Bengal
﻿﻿- Bicolor
﻿ ﻿- Calico
﻿﻿- Chimera
﻿- Japanese Bobtail
﻿ ﻿- Ocicat
﻿- Pointed
﻿﻿- Ragdoll
﻿﻿- Scottish Fold
﻿﻿- Siamese
﻿﻿- Snowshoe
﻿﻿- Socks
﻿﻿- Solid
﻿﻿- Striped
﻿﻿- Tortoiseshell
﻿﻿- Turkish Van
﻿﻿- Tuxedo
- Each breed/pattern also has a 'void' variant inspired by the vanilla void chicken
- Add as many or as few as you want to your game; each will appear as a separate breed in the game
- All skins have a corresponding head icon for the menu
- Made with the new pet hat feature in mind!
- Includes a config for adoption price in gold (default is the vanilla 40,000g price)

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43062/43062-1775954086-671416052.png[/img]﻿
[Alt text: A banner with text that reads "How to Install:"]

[b][color=#e69138]1[/color][/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[b][color=#e69138]2[/color][/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[b][color=#e69138]3[/color][/b]. Extract into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder.
[b][color=#e69138]4[/color][/b]. Run the game through SMAPI to generate a config.json, then close.
[b][color=#e69138]5[/color][/b]. Open the config.json with a program like Notepad and use the images in the References folder to add the "Cat Breeds" you want and set the adoption price. Multiple skins are allowed, separated by commas.  If you can't get a config.json to generate, you can rename the example_config.json to config.json and use it instead. The alloptions_config.json can also be renamed to config.json if you'd like every skin available (but be warned, it's a lot!).
[b][color=#e69138]6[/color][/b]. Run the game using SMAPI to play with your new cats!

Note: Unlike my older pet mods, this no longer replaces the vanilla pet sprites. However, the process of changing your existing pets' appearance has changed in 1.6. Spoilers on this process below:

[spoiler]The mechanic of changing your pet's appearance at the Wizard's Shrine of Illusion was removed in Stardew Valley 1.6. If you don't start a new save with the pet breed you want, you have to adopt a new one with the appearance you want from Marnie. Once you've maxed hearts with your existing pet, you can adopt additional pets if you buy the new pet bowl structures from Robin, or you can buy the Butterfly Powder item from Krobus to remove your pet and adopt a new one.[/spoiler]

If you only have the first pet you chose in character creation, its appearance can be changed by using the command [font=Courier New][color=#f6b26b]debug cmenu[/color][/font] in the SMAPI console.

[color=#ffd966][u][b]Warning for co-op players:[/b][/u][/color] Due to the nature of the new breeds feature, players in co-op should all have this mod installed, with the same breeds enabled, to prevent skin errors or possible crashes. I will add a default replacement version at a later date!

This mod is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿! If you have AT, you can buy the scissors from Robin and use them on your pets without an AT pack. AT will pull from the breeds you have enabled.
